content: pg_regress / PGXS regression pattern: tests live in sql/*.sql, expected output in expected/*.out (same stem). 'make installcheck' runs each script via psql, diffs actual vs expected, writing regression.diffs in diff -c format on mismatch. Standard bootstrap workflow: create empty expected file, run once, inspect results/*.out, promote to expected/ if correct. This is the reference pattern to imitate for a lightweight plain-SQL harness without requiring a compiled C extension (test scripts + psql + diff is sufficient; full PGXS Makefile only needed if packaging as a real extension).
